bends.reason: Case note: manifest group STATE_CHECK (no bend_<seq> sections), display registration OK; every verdict below is from the 4 global raw/CAD/overlay views, and a CAD-vs-registered-scan silhouette diff found no scan outside the CAD and no uncovered CAD in any view (label areas excepted). B1 = end flange at one end of the joggled strip. Registered SIDE: scan end flange coincides with the CAD one (outer edge row 880 in both). ISO: the flange region below the strip end is filled by scan points with the CAD outline. Raw TOP: strip end is a dense edge-on line, not a flat extension. Raw SIDE: short leg at that strip end. Same side as CAD (beyond the strip, away from the tab face); not reversed.

B2 = long-edge flange of the main panel. Raw TOP: dense edge-on line along that panel edge. Registered TOP/SIDE: no scan material beyond the bend line (a flat flange would add a ~20 px strip). ISO: the flange hanging below the B2 line matches the CAD envelope (288 columns, median 0 px, p95 2 px). FRONT: nothing of the scan rises above the panel line outside the tab block, so the flange is on the CAD side (joggle-offset side, opposite the tabs); not reversed.

B3 = lip along the outer long edge of the joggled strip. Raw TOP: dense edge-on band on the strip's outer edge; raw FRONT: lip visible at the strip end. Registered FRONT: scan lip coincides with the CAD lip (about cols 156-163, rows 980-999). No scan beyond the bend line in TOP. Direction matches CAD; not reversed.

B4 = lower joggle bend (strip to wall). Raw FRONT: clear Z-offset profile (strip, wall, panel). Registered FRONT: bottom edge within +/-1 px of CAD over 49 columns except 4 px at this corner (bend radius). B4 and B11 are an opposite-sense pair (B11 is the reverse of B4), and the offset goes to the same side as the CAD (strip offset to the face opposite the tabs).

B5 = tip/hook bend of the hooked tab in the slot at the B2-side of the panel (CAD SIDE puts the B5 line about 27 px above panel level, with the tab end turned outward). Registered SIDE: scan tip blob sits outward of the B5 line exactly like the CAD (about cols 1027-1035, bottom row 1000 in both). FRONT: tab-block top edge matches CAD within +/-1 px over 24 unobstructed columns. An unformed hook would leave the tab about 6 px taller. Same direction as CAD.

B6 = root bend of the same tab (slot outer edge, panel level). Raw TOP: the slot is fully open (a flat tab would fill it). Raw FRONT/SIDE: the tab stands out of the panel on the face opposite the joggle offset, as in the CAD (raw frame is flipped). Registered ISO: the visible slot-opening shape matches the CAD. Not reversed.

B7 = tip/hook bend of the hooked tab in the slot at the B10-side of the panel. Registered SIDE: scan tip blob sits outward of the B7 line like the CAD (about cols 1378-1386, bottom row 1000 in both). FRONT: tab height matches CAD within +/-1 px (an unformed hook would add about 6 px). Same direction as CAD.

B8 = root bend of that tab. Raw TOP: the slot is open; raw SIDE: a separate protrusion for this tab. Registered ISO: the slot opening matches the CAD. The tab stands out on the face opposite the joggle offset, as in the CAD; not reversed.

B9 = end flange at the other end of the joggled strip. Registered SIDE: scan end feature coincides with the CAD one (top row 879 vs 880). Raw TOP: dense edge-on line at that strip end; raw SIDE: short leg at that end. Same side as CAD; not reversed. (ISO/TOP labels cover this end, so the decision rests on SIDE plus the raw views.)

B10 = the other long-edge flange of the panel. Raw TOP: dense edge-on line along that edge. Registered TOP/ISO/SIDE: no scan material beyond the bend line, and the SIDE edge feature matches. FRONT: nothing above the panel line outside the tab block, so it is on the joggle-offset side as in the CAD; not reversed.

B11 = upper joggle bend (wall to panel), the opposite-sense partner of B4. Raw FRONT: wall rises to the panel. Registered FRONT/TOP/ISO/SIDE: wall and panel coincide with the CAD. Direction matches (the Z-offset is not mirrored).

B12 = lip on the panel's far short edge. Raw TOP: dense edge-on line, with the flat corner ears protruding beyond it as in the CAD (a flat lip would make that edge flush with the ears). Registered FRONT: scan lip coincides with the CAD lip and hangs to the same (joggle-offset) side. Registered TOP/ISO: no scan beyond the B12 line; not reversed.
